fluff.overview:
The Taurian Defense Force assigns conventional infantry to garrison and planetary defense roles across the Concordat, where citizen-soldiers serve out of patriotic duty rather than mere obligation. Jump platoons provide the vertical mobility that Taurian garrison commanders prize for defending the rough terrain and broken ground found on many Concordat border worlds. Their ability to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions gives them a tactical advantage over standard foot infantry.

Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
